readme.section: Introduction
readme.text:
dsh-zvec-grep

Semantic workspace search for dsh agents: hybrid BM25 + vector + RRF over a local zg index, with a search-first gate on grep and rg.

readme.section: Introduction
Introduction
Introduction
Introduction
readme.text:
---

**A [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that gives the model semantic workspace search: three `zg_*` tools driving the local `zg` CLI (BM25 + vector + RRF), a search-first gate on grep/rg, and a settings card with daemon readiness and a rebuild button. The `zg` binary and the index stay on your machine.**

readme.section: What it does
readme.text:
- **Three model tools, one CLI underneath.** `zg_search` / `zg_index` / `zg_status` drive the `zg` CLI through the host shell. Transport defaults to `--mode auto`: server when the daemon is ready, silent fallback to direct otherwise - nothing starts a daemon for you.
- **A search-first gate.** In an indexed workspace, grep/rg (shell command or native tool) is refused until a successful `zg_search` has run; each search re-arms a quota for a time window.
- **A systemPrompt routing section** (`zvec-grep-routing`, order 1550) plus a `tools.guard` backstop: `zg_index` requires an explicit confirm, and every root passes one shared predicate in both guard and execute.
- **A web settings card** ("zvec-grep (zg)"): default embedding, limit, gate values, a daemon-readiness line, and a "rebuild workspace" button whose jobs live in the official host job registry.
- **No index required to start.** `zg_search` can fall back to zg's exhaustive lexical channel (the `rg` switch); a never-indexed root fails loudly instead of being indexed silently.

readme.section: Install
readme.text:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @jayyuen66/dsh-zvec-grep
```

Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove @jayyuen66/dsh-zvec-grep`. The package is on the public npm registry; no credentials, no scoped-registry line.

readme.section: Install
readme.text:
- **Node.js `>= 24.9`** (ESM-only; that floor is what makes `require()` of an ESM entry work, hence `engines.node`). - **Host `dsh` on the `0.2.1-rc.5` or `0.2.2-alpha.3` line.** The host reads `engines.dsh` (`^0.2.1-rc.5 || ^0.2.2-alpha.3`) and it **decides alone** - with that field present, compatibility is judged before `peerDependencies` is ever consulted, prereleases included. Any `0.2.x` at or above `0.2.1-rc.5` passes the host gate; on the `0.2.2` prerelease line, strict npm peer resolution starts at `0.2.2-alpha.3`. `0.3.0` and later need the risk grant `dsh plugin --profile

allow-version @ --dsh-version --accept-risk`. The support window rolls: at publish time this package is checked against every released host version inside the window - the judgement is the host's `--dump-config` layer line for this package, while the settings card and its namespace calls are verified once in full on the release's development baseline - and re-verified once the window moves, so the version number in this bullet is not a standing promise. - **No `@deepseek-ai/*` under `dependencies`, by contract** (`test/publish-manifest.test.ts`). Profiles install with `nodeLinker:

readme.section: Shared version floor
readme.text: If your profile pins `@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared` with a pnpm `overrides` entry, that pin must be at least the version this package declares. A lower pin installs a copy without the names imported at runtime, and the host reports `N entries did not activate` with `does not provide an export named ...` at boot - installs fine, never loads, invisible to per-repository CI.

readme.section: Verify it is live
readme.text:
1. **The layer is mounted.** `dsh --profile web --dump-config` ends with `# == @jayyuen66/dsh-zvec-grep` plus `- id: zvec-grep`. That command is the only accepted signal and is **not read-only** - read layer lines from stdout **and** check stderr separately; accept both `# == <layer>` and `# == <layer>, patched by <path>`.
2. **The tools answer.** Ask the model to run `zg_status` on the current workspace: it executes and passes zg's own output through. "Unknown tool" means the bundle layer is not mounted.
3. **The gate refuses - in an indexed workspace.** With `enforceSearchFirst` on and a manifest under `<root>/.zvec-grep/`, grep/rg is refused with the "no zg_search has run yet" message until one successful search. Without an index there is nothing to gate.
4. **The card renders.** The settings page lists "zvec-grep (zg)" with the six editable values, the readiness line (empty when the probe cannot answer) and the rebuild button; a toggle plus **Save** round-trips with a 200.
5. **No host copy in the profile.** A scratch profile's `node_modules/` holds `@jayyuen66/` and no `@deepseek-ai/` directory.

readme.section: What it does not provide
readme.text:
- **No HTTP route of its own.** The card's data plane is the official Typert Remote namespace `zvecGrepRebuild` through the host `/api` gateway; auth, Host/DNS-rebinding/Origin checks and body limits are all the gateway's.
- **No CLI subcommand.** `dsh zvec-grep …` does not exist.
- **No daemon lifecycle.** `zg server on` is the user's action; this package only reads readiness.
- **No ripgrep dependency.** rg appears only inside the gate predicate.
- **Nothing written to the host data directory.** What lands on disk is zg's business, not this package's: its index/manifest `.zvec-grep/` under the searched root, its global home `~/.zvec-grep` (config, locks, models), and embedding weights fetched per `hfEndpoint`. This package itself writes nothing.
- Required surfaces: `settings` / `shell` / `tools` / `systemPrompt` / `timer` (all in `inject`). The host `jobs` service is optional - without it the rebuild paths refuse and spawn nothing; the three tools keep working.

readme.section: Enabling it in dsh
readme.text:
- `dsh.bundle.patch` points at `cordis.patch.yml`, whose `insert:` block carries **two entries**: `- name: "@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared"` (the supplier of the card components, deliberately **without an `id`** so the plugin page does not list it as a switchable component) and `- id: zvec-grep` with `name: "@jayyuen66/dsh-zvec-grep"` - the **bare package name** is what makes the host scan the client half. Bundle installation goes through pnpm (>= 12.3.0).
- A missing injected surface keeps cordis from activating the entry (startup diagnostic: `pending (waiting for service: …)`); a malformed ctx throws `required services … missing` from apply.
- The card is registered in the `plugins.bundle.config` slot keyed by the **bundle package name**; the settings namespace and `configForms` reads stay the bare entry id `zvec-grep` (implicit registration by entry id).
- The rebuild read surface is installed on the apply fiber - no `webServer` dependency, no child fiber. On a TUI host the service still registers; the card simply has nowhere to render.
- The status poll is the client's own timer (2000 ms), not a server push; every read answers a result object, never a thrown error.
- Deployment d

readme.section: Tools exposed to the model
readme.text: Output is plain text; timeouts 5 min (search) / 10 min (index) / 60 s (status); stdout capped at 400000 bytes, truncated to the tail with a note. Sandbox runner failure, policy denial and a genuine zg failure are told apart; incomplete results are flagged. A `root` must be a string, and the constructed command is capped in UTF-8 bytes (not code units): a non-string root or an over-long command is refused instead of falling back to the session workspace or hitting the OS argument limit. A `limit` outside 1-50 is refused the same way, naming the allowed range - a silently clamped count would read as the truth about this search; omit it for the default.

readme.section: zg_search
readme.text:
- At least one of query / queries / fts / vector (32 routes max, 4000 chars each); the four filter fields (`globs` / `insensitiveGlobs` / `fileTypes` / `excludedFileTypes`) take a single string or an array (128 items, 1024 chars each).
- `symbolTypes` is zg's closed set, **lowercase only** (`module` / `class` / `interface` / `function` / `value` / `alias`); invalid values are refused before the command is built, without case folding.
- `preview`: `none` / `short` (default) / `full`. `refresh`: `wait` (default) / `off` / `background` - `background` needs a **ready daemon** and is refused before the command is built when there is none (the way out is `zg server on`, or unpinning `clientMode` from `direct`).
- A **hit summary** at the tail reports two counts separately: the sum of per-group `hits:` and distinct locations after dedup (relative path + line range) - one location hit by several groups must not pass as the hit total. A group at exactly `--limit` is an observation only; zg gives no truncation signal.
- `trace` passes through `--trace` (per-hit recall routes, ranks, scores); the dedup key strips the score, which differs per group.

readme.section: zg_index
readme.text:
- `confirm` is required and must be true (rejected twice, by the required check and by the guard). Building never happens implicitly.
- `background=true` spawns the zg process, registers it in the host job registry, attaches the timeout reaper and **returns a job id immediately**. It reuses the **same** spawn/register/claim steps as the card (one shared function), the per-root claim is mutually exclusive across both entry points, and without a job registry it **does not spawn at all**. Until it settles, search on that root waits and retries, and the gate is suspended.
- An explicit embedding goes through an **assembly-time allowlist** (the local catalog - the card's dropdown list); anything else is refused. Switching embedding only takes effect with `rebuild=true`.
- `resetPaths=true` clears the inherited file-selection settings and composes with this call's filters; it is refused together with `drop`.
- `drop=true` refuses every index-side parameter (filters, rebuild, embedding, depth, …) instead of silently ignoring it; the command then contains only the deletion.
- `ignoreFiles` entries must name an existing, readable file. A missing or unreadable path is rejected before zg runs

readme.section: zg_status
readme.text:
- root + checkReady, for diagnosing a missing/failed/cancelled index or watching progress.
- `checkReady=true`: the report still goes to stdout and only the exit code expresses readiness - not-ready is a conclusion, not a failure. The report is returned verbatim with one appended line; an empty report with a non-zero exit still throws.
- While a rebuild of the same root is running, the tool returns the rebuild projection and starts no subprocess.

readme.section: The rg switch
readme.text:
- `rg` unset: with no index in the workspace **or any ancestor**, the search falls back to exhaustive matching with a prepended note ("literal line matches, not semantic ranking"). `rg=true` forces it; `rg=false` refuses the fallback (zg then reports `WORKSPACE_INDEX_NOT_FOUND`).
- Exhaustive search grants **no** grep/rg quota: it reads no index. Flag conflicts (`preview` / `refresh` / `symbol-type` / `prefer-symbol` / `fuse` / `fts` / `vector`, `trace`, plus a non-empty `queries` - the exhaustive channel takes a single `query` as the pattern) are refused at assembly time with the conflicts listed; there is no hit summary (no `hits:` lines to count).

readme.section: Root rules
readme.text:
- `root` is optional in all three tools (defaults to the session workspace). Validation: absolute path starting with `/`, lexically normalised; empty/non-string/NUL/relative/escaping `..` and `/` itself are refused; a missing directory is reported as such, not as a spawn ENOENT.
- A root outside the session workspace passes only via the "ancestor or descendant" branch of the shared predicate (`judgeRoot`), and every accepted root is registered in the observed-workspace whitelist the card's rebuild draws on. Guard and execute share the predicate - nothing is refused twice with different wording.

readme.section: The search-first gate
readme.text:
- **What counts as searching**: after quote/comment-aware tokenising of a bash/pwsh command string, grep/egrep/fgrep/rg at a command position, plus the native grep tool. `--help` / `--version`, `echo "grep x"` and commit messages do not.
- **Quota per "session x index root"**: each successful, **index-reading** `zg_search` re-arms `grepBudgetPerSearch` calls valid for `unlockWindowMin` minutes (an exhaustive lexical fallback also "succeeds" but grants no quota); the index root is the root itself or its nearest indexed ancestor (up to 8 levels up). The gate yields only when the host supplies a step-admission view (`toolSet`) without `zg_search` in it - hosts that provide no admission info keep the plain criteria.
- **Partitioning uses the root session** (walked up `header.parentSession`): the main agent and its subagents **share one quota**. Degradation never throws - a missing parent stops at the last known hop, a cycle stops before the first repeat.
- **Step admission stands the gate down**: when the host supplies a `toolSet` and this step's view does not admit `zg_search` (a restricted subagent or a conditional-tool step), grep/rg are not blocked - requiring a call this step cann

readme.section: Settings
readme.text: Namespace `zvec-grep` equals the settings entry id; the schema has 16 fields with built-in defaults, 6 of them volatile and on the card.

readme.section: Settings
readme.text:
| Field | Type | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultEmbedding` | string | `local/qwen3-embedding-0.6b` | Embedding for **new** indexes; switching an existing one needs a rebuild |
| `defaultLimit` | natural, 1-50 | `10` | Default hit limit for `zg_search` |
| `hfEndpoint` | string | China-reachable HF-compatible mirror | Another mirror, or empty for the official HF |
| `enforceSearchFirst` | boolean | `true` | The search-first gate |
| `grepBudgetPerSearch` | natural, 1-20 | `3` | grep/rg calls each successful search re-arms |
| `unlockWindowMin` | natural, 1-240 | `10` | Minutes that quota stays valid |

readme.section: Settings
readme.text: There are also **non-volatile deployment values**, 10 of them off the card; the row `config:` in `cordis.yml` is the only way to change them: `searchTimeoutMs=300000`, `statusTimeoutMs=60000`, `indexTimeoutMs=600000` (also the rebuild kill timer), `stdoutMaxBytes=400000`, `clientMode=auto`, `rebuildWaitMs=120000`, the remote-embedding trio and `requireApprovalForExplicitRoot` (below). Precedence: card value > row config > `.default()`; an explicitly absent row field does not override.

readme.section: Remote embedding
readme.text: Off by default: `allowRemoteEmbedding=false`, `remoteEmbeddingEndpoint=""`, `remoteEmbeddingApiKeyFrom=""`. While off, an explicit embedding must be in the local catalog at assembly time. Once open:

readme.section: Remote embedding
readme.text:
- Endpoint and credential reach zg **only via environment variables** (`ZVEC_GREP_ENDPOINT` / `ZVEC_GREP_API_KEY`), never argv - the command string is echoed as a job label on the card.
- The credential field holds the **name** of the host env var carrying the secret, not the secret; the host scrubs inherited KEY/SECRET/TOKEN names, so only an explicit forward reaches zg.
- The plugin does **not** pass `--allow-remote`: zg still requires a one-time `zg auth grant <root> --capability embedding --scope workspace`.

readme.section: Asking before an explicit root
readme.text: `requireApprovalForExplicitRoot=false` by default. When on, an explicit `root` that would pass via the "ancestor or descendant" branch triggers one user confirmation (`tools/pre-execute` → `{kind:'ask'}` → `ctx.approval`). The ask shares the root predicate (`judgeRoot`), so calls that would be refused anyway - or need no authorization - are not bothered. Three dead ends are known: `never`-approval presets reject the ask deterministically, delegated subagents are pinned to `never` (the switch has no effect there), and a missing approval service fails closed. The confirmation **only ever adds** a step: an out-of-scope root stays refused even after approval.

readme.section: Support surface
readme.text:
- **POSIX hosts (Linux / macOS).** The root predicate accepts only `/`-rooted absolute paths, the command line is POSIX-shaped (`shq()` escaping into `bash -c`), and the manifest comparison splits on `/`.
- **Windows is out of scope, fail-fast.** A `C:\Users\…` workspace makes all three tools refuse at the root check with the reason - no wrong-path zg command is ever built. Real support means changing the predicate itself (drive letters/UNC, a second command form, `/`-based tokenising); that is a design change this package does not pretend to make.
- **CI splits accordingly**: the ubuntu job is the full gate (including the four 100% coverage thresholds); other platforms run only the checks that need no on-disk workspace and do not judge coverage. The reasoning lives in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

readme.section: External dependency
readme.text:
- The binary dependency is **zg** (`npm install -g @zvec/zvec-grep`). Not on PATH → exit 127 → "zg is not installed or not on PATH", kept separate from "the sandbox runner never started".
- Upstream is `@zvec/zvec-grep` (provides the `zg` bin), repository https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-grep, **Apache-2.0**. This package shells out to the CLI; it contains and redistributes no upstream source.
- Version floor `0.2.2` (`MINIMUM_ZG_VERSION` in `lib/zg-version.ts`): below it the plugin stops before dispatch and names the actual version - older releases can parse the same argv as something else entirely.
- Local embeddings load through zg's backends (qwen3/embeddinggemma via llama-cpp, potion-* via model2vec, the rest via transformers-js); weights download with `HF_ENDPOINT` injected from `hfEndpoint`.

readme.section: Daemon (server mode)
readme.text:
- Direct and server are **two capability surfaces**, not a speed knob: direct cold-loads the embedding model on every query; watcher-driven incremental refresh, `refresh=background` and a resident model pool exist only in server mode. Upstream probes readiness for `auto` but never starts a daemon.
- This package does not start one either - `zg server on` leaves a detached process and a token file, which is the user's decision. It makes the difference **explicit** instead: the exit code of `zg server status --check-ready` is cached for 60 s (a failed probe counts as "not ready", never an infrastructure error), gates `refresh=background`, and is echoed once in `zg_status` output and once on the card. Only the `roots()` read issues the probe.
- The card's `serverReady` is `true` / `false` at the card layer — a failed or erroring probe counts as `false` ("probe failure means not ready"), so the readiness line always renders. `undefined` only survives inside the raw `roots()` payload of an older card snapshot; the live card folds it to `false`. To get the benefits, run `zg server on` in a terminal.

readme.section: Public interface
readme.text: One official Typert Remote namespace, `zvecGrepRebuild`, installed on the apply fiber. No `/_dsh/*` routes, no CSRF token, no package-owned body cap - the host `/api` gateway owns all of that.

readme.section: Public interface
readme.text:
| Method | Input | Reply |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `roots()` | - | `{ roots, serverReady }` - observed whitelist plus the readiness line; the probe folds failure to `false` (`undefined` only marks an older snapshot where the probe never ran) |
| `rebuild({ root })` | an absolute root | `{ ok: true, jobId, reused? }` or `{ ok: false, error, status }` |
| `status({ jobId })` | a job id from this package | `{ status, exitCode, root, output }` (plus `sandbox` when present) or `{ ok: false, error, status: 404 \| 503 }` |

readme.section: Public interface
readme.text:
- `rebuild` refuses non-`/`-rooted paths, roots outside the observed whitelist and vanished directories; with no `jobs` service nothing is spawned (503 arm). The per-root claim is taken before the first `await` - a second click follows the running rebuild (`reused: true`) instead of starting a second `zg` on the same index; a failed start releases the claim, so no tree stays "rebuilding".
- `status` answers only for ids in this package's side table (the last 10 settled records; running ones are never displaced) - somebody else's job cannot be read through it. The card polls every 2 s. A refusal's `status` is a **retained semantic code, not an HTTP status**, and no method throws through the gateway - a rejected call would read as one generic failure and stop the polling on a rebuild that is still running.
- Concurrency is decided by the **host registry** (measured default: the unowned bucket holds 10); when full, `rebuild` returns the official refusal naming the limit and never kills a running rebuild.

readme.section: The background job surface
readme.text: A "rebuild workspace" run is one **unowned** job in the host's `ctx.jobs` (`kind: "zvec-grep-rebuild"`, id `zvec-grep-rebuild-<hex>`). Consequences:

readme.section: The background job surface
readme.text:
- **The model can see it.** The official `job_list` / `job_output` / `job_kill` tools list the rebuild (exit code / signal in `detail`, same shape as the host's bash tool); output rides the official pull source, so the ring advances even with the panel closed.
- **Unowned means visible to every session** - a known, accepted exposure of adopting the official registry; rolling the adoption back is the only way to close it. The `status` read still answers only this package's side table.
- **Two more status words**: `stopping` (cancellation issued, not settled - shown as still running) and `failed` (the registry's own verdict, with its own message).
- The output ring keeps **UTF-8 bytes** (measured host default 262144) while the card's tail window counts **UTF-16 code units** - for CJK output the window is about 1/3 smaller than before the adoption. "Truncated" means the ring evicted its head; "buffer overflow" means bytes are really gone. The timeout notice and sandbox facts are synthesized at projection time, never written into the ring, and polling folds a reloaded registry's "unknown job" into a refusal instead of throwing through.

readme.section: Data and privacy
readme.text:
| Aspect | Content |
| --- | --- |
| Written to disk | Nothing by this package. zg owns the disk shapes: the `.zvec-grep/` index directory under the searched root, its global home `~/.zvec-grep` (config/locks/models) and the embedding-weight cache; nothing lands in the host data directory |
| What it reads | The index probe: one existence check plus one manifest read |
| Network | Only the embedding-weight download driven by `hfEndpoint`, performed by zg. Remote embedding is off by default and is a deployment decision |
| Secret exclusion | Excluded by default, case-insensitively and after your own path rules: `*.pem` / `*.key` / `*.p12` / `*.pfx` / `*.keystore` / `*.jks` / `*.ppk` / `id_rsa*` / `id_ed25519*` (excludeSecrets=false to allow). Extensionless key files are not covered - declare them via ignoreFiles |
| Hidden files | Skipped; ignore files honoured, unless noIgnore is set |
| Echoes | Bounded: stdout over the cap keeps the tail; the last 400 chars of stderr are appended. Only recognised indexing progress is dropped from stderr - degradation notices, lock conflicts and any unrecognised warning are kept; `Indexing complete` matches on whole-line equality so the partial-fa

readme.section: Known boundaries
readme.text:
- **Windows hosts are not supported** - the failure is an explicit refusal, not a wrong answer.
- **Extensionless key files** are outside the secret-exclusion rules; `id_rsa*` / `id_ed25519*` cover only the OpenSSH default names.
- **An unowned rebuild job is visible to every session** - accepted exposure of the official job registry.
- **The CJK output window shrank about a third** with the official ring (UTF-8 bytes vs UTF-16 code units).
- **zg failures without a `Code:` line cannot be attributed by code**; such replies carry a pointer to `--debug` (not passed by default - it would bloat the bounded echo these tools share).
- **Exhaustive search grants no quota and no semantic conclusion**; every automatic fallback says so up front.
- **The ask switch has three dead ends** (never-ask presets, delegated subagents, no approval service) - spelled out under Settings, not hidden.

readme.section: FAQ
readme.text:
| Question | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| grep/rg refused with "no zg_search has run yet" | The search-first gate; run zg_search. Quota spent or expired - re-search with a sharper query to refresh it, no need to disable the plugin. |
| Search times out | Default `--refresh wait` refreshes synchronously; narrow with globs/fileTypes, lower the limit, or start the daemon - direct mode cold-loads the embedding model on every call, which is why that budget is 5 minutes. |
| "the zg index lock is held by another operation (ownerOperation: ...)" | The lock holder is not a rebuild (an index refresh is the usual one), and this command does not wait for it - such an operation can run very long, and queueing behind it would be unbounded. Retry later, or query again once it settles; only a rebuild-owned lock waits and retries automatically. zg's original failure text is appended, so you can read which lock it was. |
| Rebuild refused with "not in the workspace whitelist" | That directory never had a session in this daemon; start one there first, or let the model call zg_index with confirm=true. |
| Card reports a failed rebuild although zg looks finished | Success is "completed with exit 0" - exit

readme.text:
```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check   # typecheck (three tsconfig programs) → lint → both bundle builds → vitest with coverage → format check
```

readme.section: Development
readme.text:
- Tests come in three tiers: `test/*.test.ts` (unit + mocked host context), `test/integration/*` (real host services driven through `ctx.tools.execute()` / actual `fetch`), and `test/e2e/zg-cli.test.ts` (no plugin, no mock - the built command lines against the **real zg CLI**). Host-contract bugs surface in the middle tier: a mocked context can only agree with what this package already believes.
- Coverage is **100%** across four metrics over the opted-in surface (`host.ts` + `lib/**` + the two card-side sources `src/ui-messages.ts` / `src/rebuild-reader.ts`); only the pure browser entry `src/client-entry.ts` stays outside the denominator and is exercised through the bundle.
- `host.js` / `client.js` are not committed; `prepare` / `prepack` rebuild them and two tests compare the on-disk bundle against an in-memory build byte for byte. Never hand-edit the bundles.
- Manifest gates (`test/publish-manifest.test.ts`) guard the published surface: entry targets covered by `files`, host packages out of `dependencies`, `dsh-*` pinned exactly, no local paths in artifacts. `test/dist-size.test.ts` budgets bundle bytes; `test/readme-parity.test.ts` keeps both READMEs structurally in sync.

readme.section: 它做什么
readme.text:
- **三枚模型工具，底下是一条 CLI。** zg_search / zg_index / zg_status 经宿主 shell 调 zg CLI。传输模式缺省 `--mode auto`：守护进程就绪走 server，缺席时静默落回 direct——没有任何一方替你拉起 daemon。
- **一道 search-first 门禁。** 已建索引的工作区里，grep/rg（shell 命令或原生工具）必须先有一次成功的 zg_search；每次检索重新武装一份有时效的配额。
- **一段 systemPrompt 硬规则**（`zvec-grep-routing`，order 1550）加一道 `tools.guard` 兜底：zg_index 强制显式 confirm，所有 root 在 guard 与 execute 两条路上过同一套判据。
- **一张 web 设置卡**（"zvec-grep（zg）"）：默认 embedding、limit、门禁参数、守护进程就绪行，以及「工作区重建」按钮——作业登记进官方宿主作业注册表。
- **没有索引也能起步。** zg_search 可改走 zg 的穷举词法通道（`rg` 开关）；从未建索引的 root 明确报错，而不是被静默索引。

readme.section: 安装
readme.text:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @jayyuen66/dsh-zvec-grep
```

卸载用 `dsh plugin --profile web remove @jayyuen66/dsh-zvec-grep`。包在公共 npm registry 上，不需要凭据，也不需要 scoped-registry 配置行。

readme.section: 安装
readme.text:
- **Node.js `>= 24.9`**（纯 ESM；正是这个下限让 `require()` 一枚 ESM 入口成为可能，`engines.node` 因此声明）。 - **宿主 `dsh` 在 `0.2.1-rc.5` 或 `0.2.2-alpha.3` 这条线上。** 宿主读 `engines.dsh`（`^0.2.1-rc.5 || ^0.2.2-alpha.3`）且**单独决定**——该字段在场时兼容性先于 `peerDependencies` 判定，prerelease 参与比较。`0.2.x` 里不低于 `0.2.1-rc.5` 的都通过宿主装载门；`0.2.2` 预发布线上，npm 的严格 peer 解析从 `0.2.2-alpha.3` 起算。`0.3.0` 及以上需要风险授权 `dsh plugin --profile

allow-version @ --dsh-version <确切版本> --accept-risk`。支持窗口是滚动的：本包在发布时把窗口内的每个已发布宿主版本逐版取证（判据是宿主 `--dump-config` 里本包的层行；设置卡与它的命名空间调用另在发布基线上全量取证一次），窗口滚动后重新取证，不把这一句里的版本号当长期承诺。 - **按契约，`dependencies` 下不放任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`**（`test/publish-manifest.test.ts` 钉住）。profile 以 `nodeLinker: hoisted` 与 `autoInstallPeers: false` 安装，宿主包在那里会落成真实的第二份副本；`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 用普通 `Symbol` 给调度器做键，那个 profile 里**每一次原生工具调用都抛错**，而构建、类型检查与覆盖率照绿。`@deepseek-ai/dsh*` 的 peer 写同一条支持窗口范围（`^0.2.1-rc.5 || ^0.2.2-alpha.3`），`devDependencies` 里的精确钉版才是防「第二份宿主类型面」的编译期纪律——那不是宿主会去读的声明。 - **值导入都是必需 peer。** `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 是宿主 fork（只有它的 `resolve` 认 `.volatile()` 字段）；`@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol` 提供 `TypertRemoteService` 这个要 `extends` 的类；`@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope` 提供步骤准入判定用的 `scopeOf`；shared 的 `lib/text` 自己值导入 `@deepseek-ai/dsh

readme.section: shared 的版本下限
readme.text: 如果你的 profile 用 pnpm `overrides` 把 `@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared` 钉在某个版本，那个值必须不低于本包声明的版本。钉得更低就会装到一份缺少运行期所导入名字的产物，宿主起来时报 `N entries did not activate` 加 `does not provide an export named ...`——包装得上、永远不加载，单仓 CI 看不见。

readme.section: 确认它真的在工作
readme.text:
1. **层已经进栈。** `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 末尾出现 `# == @jayyuen66/dsh-zvec-grep` 加 `- id: zvec-grep`。这条命令是唯一被接受的判据，而且**不是只读命令**——层行从 stdout 读，**并且**单独检查 stderr；`# == <layer>` 与 `# == <layer>, patched by <path>` 两种形态都要认。
2. **工具答得上来。** 让模型对当前工作区跑一次 zg_status：工具会执行并把 zg 自己的输出透传回来。回「未知工具」说明 bundle 层没进栈。
3. **门禁会拦——前提是已建索引。** `enforceSearchFirst` 开着且 `<root>/.zvec-grep/` 下有清单时，一次成功的 zg_search 之前 grep/rg 被「尚未执行过 zg_search」那句拒绝。没有索引的工作区里门禁无事可拦。
4. **卡片渲染。** 设置页列出 "zvec-grep（zg）"：六个可编辑值、就绪行（探测答不出时保持空白）与重建按钮；改一个值点**保存**以 200 落地。
5. **profile 里没有宿主副本。** 临时 profile 的 `node_modules/` 里只有 `@jayyuen66/`，没有 `@deepseek-ai/` 目录。

readme.section: 它不提供什么
readme.text:
- **没有自有 HTTP 路由。** 卡片的数据面是官方 Typert Remote 命名空间 `zvecGrepRebuild`，经宿主 `/api` 网关；认证、Host / DNS 重绑定 / Origin 判据与请求体上限都归网关。
- **没有 CLI 子命令。** `dsh zvec-grep …` 不存在。
- **不碰守护进程的生命周期。** `zg server on` 是用户的动作；本包只读就绪态。
- **不依赖 ripgrep。** rg 只出现在门禁判据里。
- **不向宿主数据目录写任何东西。** 落盘的都是 zg 的事：检索根下的 `.zvec-grep/` 索引与清单、zg 的全局 home `~/.zvec-grep`（config / 锁 / 模型）、以及按 `hfEndpoint` 下载的 embedding 权重缓存。
- 必需的服务面：settings / shell / tools / systemPrompt / timer（全在 `inject` 里）。宿主 `jobs` 服务可选——没有它时重建路径拒绝且不 spawn，三枚工具照常工作。

readme.section: 在 dsh 里启用
readme.text:
- `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`，其 `insert:` 块带**两条条目**：`- name: "@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared"`（卡片组件的供应行，**刻意不写 `id`**，所以插件页不会把它列成可停用组件）与 `- id: zvec-grep`、`name: "@jayyuen66/dsh-zvec-grep"`——让宿主扫描 client 半的是**裸包名**。bundle 安装走 pnpm（>= 12.3.0）。
- 缺任一注入服务面，cordis 就不激活本条目（启动诊断点名 `pending (waiting for service: …)`）；ctx 形状不对时 apply 抛 `required services … missing`。
- 卡片注册在 `plugins.bundle.config` 槽的 **bundle 包名**键下；设置命名空间与 `configForms` 的读仍走裸条目 id `zvec-grep`（按条目 id 隐式注册）。
- 重建读面注册在 apply fiber 上——不声明 `webServer`、没有子 fiber。TUI 宿主上服务照常注册，只是卡片没有地方渲染。
- 状态轮询是客户端自己的定时器（2000 ms），不是服务端推送；每次读都以结果对象回答，不抛错。
- 部署默认值写在注册行的 `config:` 上；优先级：卡运行时值 > 行 config > schema 的 `.default()`。

readme.section: 提供给模型的工具
readme.text: 输出为纯文本；超时 5 分钟（search）/ 10 分钟（index）/ 60 秒（status）；stdout 上限 400000 字节，超限截尾并提示。沙箱 runner 失败、策略拒绝与 zg 自身失败分开归因；结果可能不完整时显式打标。`root` 必须是字符串，构造出的命令按 UTF-8 字节（不是码元）封顶：非字符串的 root 与超长命令直接拒绝，不会回落到会话工作区，也不会撞上内核参数上限。`limit` 越出 1-50 同样直接拒绝并点名区间，不静默钳制——钳过的少结果会被模型当成这次检索的事实；省略则用默认值。

readme.section: zg_search
readme.text:
- query / queries / fts / vector 至少其一（合计 <= 32 组、单条 <= 4000 字符）；四个过滤项（`globs` / `insensitiveGlobs` / `fileTypes` / `excludedFileTypes`）收单字符串或数组（128 项、单项 <= 1024 字符）。
- `symbolTypes` 绑定 zg 的闭集，**只认小写**（`module` / `class` / `interface` / `function` / `value` / `alias`）；非法取值在构造命令前就拦，不做大小写折叠。
- `preview`：`none` / `short`（默认）/ `full`。`refresh`：`wait`（默认）/ `off` / `background`——`background` 要有**就绪的守护进程**，没有就在构造命令前拒并给出路（`zg server on`，或把 `clientMode` 从 `direct` 改回来）。
- 输出尾部一行**命中摘要**分两栏：各查询组 `hits:` 之和，与去重后不同位置数（按相对路径 + 行号范围）——同一处被多组命中时不能拿求和冒充命中总数。某组正好等于 `--limit` 只作观察陈述；zg 不提供截断信号。
- `trace` 透传 `--trace`（每条命中的召回路径、名次、分值）；摘要去重键剥掉逐组不同的分值。

readme.section: zg_index
readme.text:
- confirm 必填且必须为 true（required 校验 + guard 双层拒绝）。建索引绝不隐式发生。
- `background=true` 起 zg 进程、登记进官方作业注册表、挂超时回收后**立即交回作业号**。它与设置卡复用**同一个** spawn/登记/占位函数，同根占位跨两条入口互斥；没有作业注册表时**根本不起进程**。落定前该根的检索等待自动重试，期间门禁暂停。
- 显式 embedding 走**构造期 allowlist**（本地候选清单，即卡片下拉那份），其余引用直接拒。切换 embedding 必须 `rebuild=true` 才生效。
- `resetPaths=true` 清掉继承来的文件选择设置、再叠加本次过滤项；与 `drop` 互斥（构造期直接拒）。
- `drop=true` 与所有索引侧参数（过滤、rebuild、embedding、深度等）互斥：出现就点名拒绝，不会静默忽略；这时命令里只剩删除一件事。
- `ignoreFiles` 的每一项都必须指向存在且当前进程可读的文件。不存在或读不了会在 zg 启动前拒绝；上游遇到这种路径会让整次索引失败，并把这棵树的索引状态弄坏。

readme.section: zg_status
readme.text:
- root + checkReady，用于索引缺失/失败/取消后的诊断或显式看进度。
- `checkReady=true`：报告照常打在 stdout、只用退出码表达就绪——未就绪是结论不是失败。报告原样交回并附一行说明；报告为空的非零退出仍按失败抛。
- 同根正在重建时直接给重建投影，不启子进程。

readme.section: rg 开关
readme.text:
- `rg` 留空：工作区**及其向上各级**都没有索引时自动改走穷举匹配，并在结果前声明「这是逐行字面匹配，不是语义排序」。`rg=true` 强制；`rg=false` 拒绝改道（zg 报 `WORKSPACE_INDEX_NOT_FOUND`）。
- 穷举检索**不发放** grep/rg 配额：它不读索引。冲突旗标（`preview` / `refresh` / `symbol-type` / `prefer-symbol` / `fuse` / `fts` / `vector`、`trace`，以及非空 `queries`——穷举通道只认单条 `query`）在构造期拒绝并列出；没有 `hits:` 计数行，命中摘要自动不出。

readme.section: root 判据
readme.text:
- 三者的 root 都可省略（缺省=当前会话工作区）。校验：以 `/` 开头的绝对路径、词典归一；空串/非字符串/NUL/相对路径/越界的 `..`、归一后为 `/` 都拒；目录不存在单报「root 目录不存在」，不冒成 spawn ENOENT。
- 会话工作区之外的 root 只有走共享判据（`judgeRoot`）的「祖先/后代」分支才放行，且每个过判据的 root 都登记进卡片重建吃的观测白名单。guard 与 execute 同一套判据——不会同一件事拒两遍、说法还不同。

readme.section: search-first 门禁
readme.text:
- **什么算检索**：bash/pwsh 命令串经引号/注释感知切词后，命令位上的 grep/egrep/fgrep/rg 与原生 grep 工具。`--help` / `--version`、`echo "grep x"`、commit message 不算。
- **配额按「会话 × 索引根」**：每次成功 zg_search 重新武装 grepBudgetPerSearch 次、unlockWindowMin 分钟有效；索引根是 root 自身或含索引的最近祖先（最多上溯 8 层）。
- **分片用根会话**（沿 `header.parentSession` 上溯到顶）：主代理与子代理**共享一份额度**。上溯降级不抛错——查不到父就停在已知的最后一跳，成环就停在首次重复前。
- **步骤准入让路**：宿主提供 `toolSet` 且本步骤的视图不含 `zg_search` 时（受限子代理或条件工具步骤），grep/rg 不被拦——强迫模型去调一个本步骤调不动的工具是死路。不提供步骤准入的宿主沿用原判据。
- **「含索引」= `<root>/.zvec-grep/manifest.json` 在盘上，*并且*解析得开**：`manifestVersion` 严格等于 1、`rootPaths` 覆盖该目录（归一相等，macOS 两侧剥 `/private` 前缀）。只判目录名不够——它同时是 zg 的全局 home（`~/.zvec-grep`）；只判存在会把半截或外来的清单误判成有索引，把检索与门禁双向堵死。
- 白名单/解锁表在内存里有界（64 根 / 256 分片），命中即触摸、先过期后 LRU 淘汰；白名单条目带一天有效期。
- enforceSearchFirst=false 只关门禁；confirm 与 root 兜底照旧。

readme.section: 设置项
readme.text:
| 字段 | 类型 | 默认值 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultEmbedding` | string | `local/qwen3-embedding-0.6b` | **新建**索引用的 embedding；已有索引切换后需重建 |
| `defaultLimit` | natural，1-50 | `10` | zg_search 默认命中条数上限 |
| `hfEndpoint` | string | 国内可达的 HF 兼容镜像 | 可改别的镜像，留空走官方 HF |
| `enforceSearchFirst` | boolean | `true` | search-first 门禁 |
| `grepBudgetPerSearch` | natural，1-20 | `3` | 每次成功检索重新武装的 grep/rg 次数 |
| `unlockWindowMin` | natural，1-240 | `10` | 配额有效分钟数 |

readme.section: 设置项
readme.text: 另有**非 volatile 部署值**，共 10 枚不进卡片，cordis.yml 行 `config:` 是唯一改值入口：searchTimeoutMs=300000、statusTimeoutMs=60000、indexTimeoutMs=600000（也是重建 kill 定时器时长）、stdoutMaxBytes=400000、clientMode=auto、rebuildWaitMs=120000，加远程 embedding 三件套与 requireApprovalForExplicitRoot（见下两小节）。优先级：卡值 > 行 config > `.default()`；行里显式缺省的字段不覆盖默认。

readme.section: 远程 embedding
readme.text:
默认全关：`allowRemoteEmbedding=false`、`remoteEmbeddingEndpoint=""`、`remoteEmbeddingApiKeyFrom=""`。关着时，显式 embedding 必须落在本地候选清单里。打开后：

- 端点与凭据**只经环境变量**下发（`ZVEC_GREP_ENDPOINT` / `ZVEC_GREP_API_KEY`），绝不进 argv——整条命令会作为作业 label 回显在卡片上。
- 凭据那项填的是**宿主进程里装凭据的环境变量名**，不是密钥本身；宿主会剔掉名字含 KEY/SECRET/TOKEN 的继承变量，必须由本插件显式转发才到得了 zg。
- 本插件**不代传 `--allow-remote`**：zg 还要用户自己跑一次 `zg auth grant <root> --capability embedding --scope workspace`。

readme.section: 显式 root 前的确认
readme.text: `requireApprovalForExplicitRoot` 默认 `false`。打开后，显式给了 root、且要靠「祖先/后代」分支放行的调用会经官方 `tools/pre-execute` → `{kind:'ask'}` → `ctx.approval` 弹一次用户确认。发问判据与 root 判据同源（`judgeRoot`），注定被拒或本就无需授权的调用不受打扰。三处死路已知：`never` 审批预设确定性拒绝、委派子代理被钉死 `never`（开关对其无效）、无 approval 服务时 fail-closed。这道确认**只加不减**：越界的 root 即便「已批准」照旧被拒。

readme.section: 支持面
readme.text:
- **POSIX 宿主（Linux / macOS）。** root 判据只认 `/` 开头的绝对路径，命令行是 POSIX 形态（`shq()` 转义进 `bash -c`），清单比对按 `/` 分隔。
- **Windows 不在支持面内，fail-fast。** 会话工作区长成 `C:\Users\…` 时三个工具都在 root 判据处当场拒并说明原因——不会拿错位路径去拼 zg 命令。真要支持得改判据本身（盘符/UNC、第二套命令形态、按 `/` 的切词），本包不做也不假装能做。
- **CI 照此分工**：ubuntu 格是全部门禁（含四项 100% 覆盖率）；其它平台只跑不依赖盘上真工作区的检查、不判覆盖率。理由写在 `.github/workflows/ci.yml`。

readme.section: 外部依赖
readme.text:
- 二进制依赖是 **zg**（`npm install -g @zvec/zvec-grep`）。不在 PATH 时 shell 回 exit 127，工具回「zg 未安装或不在 PATH」，与「沙箱 runner 没起来」分开归因。
- 上游即 `@zvec/zvec-grep`（提供 `zg` 这枚 bin），仓库 https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-grep，许可 **Apache-2.0**。本包只经宿主 shell 调那枚 CLI，不含也不分发上游源码。
- 版本下限 `0.2.2`（`lib/zg-version.ts` 的 `MINIMUM_ZG_VERSION`）：低于它就在下发命令前停住并点名实际版本——更老的 zg 可能把同一串 argv 解成别的东西。
- 本地 embedding 由 zg 侧后端加载（qwen3/embeddinggemma 走 llama-cpp，potion-* 走 model2vec，其余走 transformers-js）；权重按 hfEndpoint 注入 HF_ENDPOINT 后下载。

readme.section: 守护进程
readme.text:
- direct 与 server 是**两种能力面**，不是快慢之分：direct 每次查询都冷加载 embedding 模型；增量刷新（watcher）、`refresh=background` 与常驻模型池只在 server 模式下存在。上游对 `auto` 只做就绪探测、不拉起 daemon。
- 本包也不拉——`zg server on` 会留下 detached 进程与 token 文件，那是用户的决定。本包做的是把差异**显式化**：按 60 秒 TTL 缓存 `zg server status --check-ready` 的退出码（探测失败按未就绪收口，绝不外抛基础设施故障），据此收口 `refresh=background`，并在 `zg_status` 输出尾与卡片各回显一行。探测只由 `roots()` 读面发出。
- 卡片的 `serverReady` 在卡片层只可能是 `true` / `false`——探测失败按未就绪收口，就绪行恒渲染。`undefined` 只会出现在旧快照的 `roots()` 原始载荷里（那一次探测压根没跑），实时卡片把它折成 `false`。想要红利就在终端里跑 `zg server on`。

readme.section: 对外接口
readme.text:
一枚官方 Typert Remote 命名空间 `zvecGrepRebuild`，注册在 apply fiber 上。没有 `/_dsh/*` 路由、没有 CSRF token、也不自带 body 上限——都由宿主 `/api` 网关承担。

| 方法 | 入参 | 回执 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `roots()` | - | `{ roots, serverReady }`——观测白名单加就绪行；探测失败折成 `false`（`undefined` 只标记旧快照里那次探测没跑过） |
| `rebuild({ root })` | 一个绝对 root | `{ ok: true, jobId, reused? }` 或 `{ ok: false, error, status }` |
| `status({ jobId })` | 本包发的作业号 | `{ status, exitCode, root, output }`（有沙箱时带 `sandbox`）或 `{ ok: false, error, status: 404 \| 503 }` |

readme.section: 对外接口
readme.text:
- `rebuild` 拒绝非 `/` 路径、白名单之外的 root、已消失的目录；无 `jobs` 服务时一条都不 spawn（503 臂）。同根占位在第一个 `await` 前取——第二次点击跟随在跑的那条（`reused: true`），不会在同一份索引上再起一条 zg；启动失败归还占位，没有树会被永久标成「重建中」。
- `status` 只认本包侧表里的 id（最近 10 条已落定记录，在跑的永不淘汰），别人的作业经它读不到。卡片每 2 秒轮询。拒绝里的 `status` 是**保留的语义码，不是 HTTP 状态**；三个方法都不把异常抛穿网关——一次被拒的调用对卡片只是一条笼统失败，会停掉还在跑的重建的轮询。
- 并发由**宿主注册表**决定（实测默认未拥有桶 10）；满员时 `rebuild` 交回官方点名文案的拒绝，绝不杀在跑的重建。

readme.section: 后台作业面
readme.text: 一次「工作区重建」是宿主 `ctx.jobs` 里的一枚**未拥有**作业（`kind: "zvec-grep-rebuild"`，id 形如 `zvec-grep-rebuild-<hex>`）。三个后果：

readme.section: 后台作业面
readme.text:
- **模型侧能看见。** 官方 `job_list` / `job_output` / `job_kill` 列得出这次重建（退出码与信号走 `detail`，与宿主 bash 工具同形）；输出走官方 pull source，面板关着环也照常前进。
- **未拥有 ⇒ 对全部会话可见**——采用官方注册表的已知且被接受的暴露面，要收回只有回滚换装一条路。`status` 读面仍只认本包侧表。
- **多了两个状态词**：`stopping`（取消已发出、未落定——按仍在跑显示）与 `failed`（注册表侧判定，带专门文案）。
- 输出环按 **UTF-8 字节**留存（实测宿主默认 262144），卡片的尾窗按 **UTF-16 码元**计——中文输出的窗比换装前小约 1/3。「已截断」指环裁掉了头部；「缓冲区溢出」指字节真丢了。超时说明与沙箱事实在投影时合成、不进环；注册表被重载时轮询把 unknown job 折成拒绝结果，不抛穿。

readme.section: 数据与隐私
readme.text:
| 口径 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 写盘 | 本包不写任何文件。落盘形状归 zg：检索根下的 `.zvec-grep/` 索引目录、全局 home `~/.zvec-grep`（config/锁/模型）与 embedding 权重缓存；宿主数据目录里什么都不落 |
| 本包读什么 | 索引探测：一次存在性检查加读一次清单 |
| 网络 | 只有 zg 按 hfEndpoint 下载 embedding 权重。远程 embedding 默认关闭、属部署决定 |
| 密钥排除 | 默认排除、大小写不敏感、且排在你的路径规则之后：`*.pem` / `*.key` / `*.p12` / `*.pfx` / `*.keystore` / `*.jks` / `*.ppk` / `id_rsa*` / `id_ed25519*`（excludeSecrets=false 可关）。**无扩展名**的密钥文件不覆盖——走 ignoreFiles 声明 |
| 隐藏文件 | 默认不收；ignore 文件默认生效（noIgnore 可关） |
| 回显 | 有界：stdout 超限截尾；stderr 尾部 400 字符一并回显。stderr 只丢弃认得的索引进度——退化提示、锁冲突与任何没认出来的警告一律保留；`Indexing complete` 按整行相等匹配，部分失败的那句变体不会被吞 |
| 重建路径 | 模型侧 `zg_index`（rebuild=true、confirm=true）或卡片按钮；删除是 `zg_index` drop=true。卸载时侧表回收、在跑的作业经注册表 kill |

readme.section: 已知边界
readme.text:
- **Windows 宿主不支持**——失败是明确的拒绝，不是错误的答案。
- **无扩展名的密钥文件**不在排除规则覆盖内；`id_rsa*` / `id_ed25519*` 只覆盖 OpenSSH 默认命名。
- **未拥有的重建作业对全部会话可见**——官方作业注册表的被接受暴露面。
- **中文输出窗缩小约三分之一**——官方环按 UTF-8 字节、卡片按 UTF-16 码元的代价。
- **没有 `Code:` 行的 zg 失败无法按码归因**；这种回显带「可加 `--debug` 复跑」的指引（不默认带 `--debug`，它会撑爆给模型读的有界回显）。
- **穷举检索不发放配额、也不产出语义结论**；每次自动改道都带前置声明。
- **确认开关有三处死路**（never 审批预设、委派子代理、无 approval 服务）——写在设置项一节，不藏着。

readme.section: 常见问题
readme.text:
| 问题 | 回答 |
| --- | --- |
| grep/rg 被拒且提示「尚未执行过 zg_search」 | 这是 search-first 门禁，先 zg_search；配额用尽或过期同理，换个更准的 query 重搜续上，不必关插件。 |
| 检索超时 | 默认 `--refresh wait` 同步刷新索引；用 globs/fileTypes 缩小范围、调小 limit，或起守护进程——直连模式每次冷加载 embedding 模型，那才是预算给到 5 分钟的原因。 |
| 报错「zg 索引锁正被其他操作占用（ownerOperation: …）」 | 占锁方不是重建（常见是增量刷新），这一条命令不为它等待——那类操作可能跑很久，排队等于无界挂起。稍后重试，或等它落定后再查；只有重建占锁走自动等待重试。zg 的原始失败文本随行，可核对是哪一把锁。 |
| 重建被拒「root 不在观测白名单内」 | 该目录从未在本 daemon 开过会话；先在那里起会话，或让模型带 confirm=true 调 zg_index。 |
| 卡片显示重建失败而 zg 看着像跑完了 | 成功判据是 completed 且 exit 0——exit 127（zg 没装）也落在 completed，看输出尾部。 |
| 从未建索引的 root | zg_search 明确报错；建索引只在明确请求时由 zg_index 做。 |
| 换了 embedding 却搜不到语义结果 | 切换 embedding 必须 rebuild=true 重建后才生效。 |

readme.section: 开发
readme.text:
```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check   # 类型检查（三个 tsconfig 程序）→ lint → 两个 bundle 构建 → 带覆盖率的测试 → 格式检查
```

readme.section: 开发
readme.text:
- 测试分三层：`test/*.test.ts`（单测 + mock 宿主上下文）、`test/integration/*`（真宿主服务，经 `ctx.tools.execute()` / 真 `fetch` 驱动）、`test/e2e/zg-cli.test.ts`（无插件无替身——构造出的命令行直喂**真 zg CLI**）。宿主契约的缺陷出在中间层：mock 上下文只会同意本包已经相信的事。
- 覆盖率四项 **100%**，分母是选入的面（`host.ts` + `lib/**`，以及卡片侧两个可单测源文件 `src/ui-messages.ts` / `src/rebuild-reader.ts`）；只有纯浏览器入口 `src/client-entry.ts` 在分母外，经 bundle 覆盖。
- `host.js` / `client.js` 不入库；`prepare` / `prepack` 现产，两条测试拿磁盘产物与内存构建逐字节比。发布物不手改。
- manifest 门（`test/publish-manifest.test.ts`）守发布面：入口目标被 `files` 覆盖、宿主包不进 `dependencies`、`dsh-*` 精确钉、产物无本机路径。`test/dist-size.test.ts` 设体积预算，`test/readme-parity.test.ts` 钉两份 README 的结构对等。

readme.section: 许可
readme.text:
MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。源码在 [github.com/JayYuen666/dsh-zvec-grep](https://github.com/JayYuen666/dsh-zvec-grep)。问题请提到那个仓库的 issue tracker。

本插件驱动的 `zg` CLI 属上游 `@zvec/zvec-grep`，许可 **Apache-2.0**。本包不含上游源码、不随包附其许可文本；若把两者放在一起再分发，请按各自许可分别保留完整声明。这条边界记录在 [`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](./THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。
